scope: FOC-only reference control-model repair and rerun. No CAD, schematic, BOM, PCB, firmware image, or central report was modified.

confirmed_motor_input.evidence: FOC驱动模块/参考资料/电机资料/N5065参数证据.md

reference_control_configuration.current_controller: dq average-plant PI with vector voltage saturation and back-calculation anti-windup
reference_control_configuration.regen_policy: Negative q-current request is allowed only with fresh positive power allocated to this board. Missing, zero, invalid-generation, expired or unqualified shared budget denies new regenerative request.
reference_control_configuration.power_limit_source: per_board_power_w, preallocated from shared battery/DC-DC absorption capability; no board may reuse the full shared budget
reference_control_configuration.600w_value: sensitivity-only; not a default, capability, or approved limit
reference_control_configuration.screening_limit_boundary: 120 A is a model screening line, not a confirmed motor rating or absolute hardware maximum

limited_100a_20uh_sensitivity_grid.classification: assumption sweep only; the swept R/L values are not measured motor bounds

cases: synthetic qualified 1800 W budget allocates 900 W + 900 W
two_board_budget_tests.qualification_boundary: Logic tests only. The synthetic 1800 W qualification flag is not actual battery/DC-DC sink evidence.

cached_generation_pwm_reuse_test.requirement: Generation anti-replay is checked once by the receive/update API; the accepted generation and allocation are cached and reused on PWM calls until TTL expiry. Each PWM checks age/TTL, not generation replay.

ttl_expiry_loaded_regen_case.test_case: single-board -100 A regen request, 100 ms capability TTL, simulated to 500 ms

local_per_board_absorber_sensitivity_req.qualification: 18.179 J is only the modeled post-TTL tail in this single-board sensitivity case, not a full hardware absorber rating. Actual sink qualification must also cover possible sustained mechanical/bus energy, stored magnetic energy, source backfeed, temperature, tolerance, and fault duration.

ttl_expiry_loaded_regen_case.status: FAIL: TTL expiry zeros the request, not the physical current or regen energy; no qualified local sink/isolating path is established

analog_current_limit_boundary.evidence: FOC驱动模块/原理图准备/电流窗口误差核算.md
analog_current_limit_boundary.limitations: Static tolerance corners are not a guaranteed sub-120 A fast clamp. CSA drift maximum, reference transients, PWM ripple, propagation max, break-to-gate delay, and board parasitics are not closed; do not count the comparator threshold as a 120 A runtime limiter.

safe_5v_loss.condition: Existing ngspice behavior model assumes 1.8 kW regen persists after SAFE_5V loss at 100 ms.
safe_5v_loss.interpretation: Conditional model trend only. SAFE_5V supplies comparator/reference and dump-control circuitry; loss of the rail does not prove a guaranteed dump or galvanic/current isolation. The 1 s post-threshold voltage is not treated as valid prediction.
safe_5v_loss.minimum_open_design: A dump path that stays effective when SAFE_5V fails, with independently qualified drive/sense and a bounded energy source; proposed dual-rail isolation/OR remains unrated and is not implemented.

official_drc.warning_detail: Current official API record contains only the aggregate count; revised per-warning GUI detail is unavailable. DRC warning-free acceptance remains FAIL/open.
official_drc.evidence: FOC驱动模块/检查/未通过项修复/官方DRC与逐项日志.json

minimal_evidence_needed_for_hardware_clo: Motor phase resistance and effective inductance over rotor angle, current, and temperature; back-EMF/speed range; definition and duty/thermal condition of the seller's 80 A and 1.8 kW specifications.

Actual shunt/CSA/reference/ADC gain, offset, filtering and synchronous sampling phase; deployed PWM/ISR/driver shutdown latency; measured switching ripple and maximum current slew; compare measured peaks against MOSFET, shunt, connector and motor limits.

Qualified per-board DC/DC/battery absorption power and energy allocation for both FOC boards, including a generation/TTL update source; measured behavior and independently powered local energy path during SAFE_5V loss; thermal and bus-voltage limits.
Official revised DRC warning-by-warning report or GUI evidence to classify the remaining five warnings.
